name: TodayTix
note: Theatre and live-experience ticketing platform; Charlton Athletic's Official Experience Partner on a two-year deal from June 2026, on the back of the men's and women's first-team shirts. TodayTix Group was acquired in October 2025 by MARI, the events and experiences company founded by Ariel Emanuel (marigrp.com press release); press reports say MARI is backed by Apollo Global Management and RedBird Capital Partners (the Guardian, 20 Oct 2025: 'Mari is backed by Apollo Global Management and RedBird Capital Partners'). No state ownership and no record evidence found. Propose: none.
